x: Clark raced away at the start and at Beverley Brook was already making the handicapper feel nervous, for so early in the race he had set up a good lead, being followed by H Cook, Bicknell of Thames Valley and Browning of Ashcombe Footer and Klophin being in close attendance.
Nuti (T.V.H.), and Browning (Ashcombe) made the pace for the first mile (time 4-56), while the Belgrave men packed splendidly and we had all our six together at half distance.

Then came Warboys, Nuti, of the "Valley," Robertshaw, Dewberry, Carter, with a sprained ankle, Fletcher, who passed six in the last mile, Browning (Ashcombe), Smith, at last finding a bit of form, and Joe Flower.

Nearly all the distance was led by Browning (Birchfield) but on the penultimate lap Thames Valley's Scottish International and Oxford colleague of Ranjit, Alistair Wood, sprinted ahead to cover the last 660 yards in 95 secs.
